style_when: the article is a purely conceptual synthesis or policy dilemma where no physical facility, machine, or supply chain exists, and an elegant abstract paper silhouette states the idea. Never reach for paper collage when the story describes physical manufacturing, freight, energy, hardware, or heavy infrastructure — use cinematic still or telephoto industry instead
prompt: Minimalist editorial cut-paper collage, crisp cut-out object silhouettes, halftone newsprint texture. An asymmetrical, off-centre arrangement of two stylized cut-paper object silhouettes: a heavy circular calendar dial interlocking with and trapping a blank stock certificate silhouette. Layered deliberately on a real table surface. Hand-torn rag paper with visible fibre, physical cast shadows under each layered tier, one raking directional light throwing sharp shadows. Muted modern editorial palette of charcoal, cream, and burnt orange, crisp clean edges, generous negative space.
negative_prompt: text, typography, numbers, letters, garbled text, watermarks, signature
rationale: The story is a purely conceptual policy dilemma about a tax rule and a calendar window. Paper collage perfectly captures this abstract financial constraint without forcing a literal or unrelated physical environment.
subject: a circular calendar dial overlapping and trapping a stock certificate silhouette
core_thesis: Harvesting a loss on employer stock is blocked by a 61-day window, penalizing concentrated holders who want to retain their position.
